raw_response:
*Let me think about this year the way I always do — what worked last year, what I can afford, what the weather's been like.*

Well, spring's here again. My husband works construction in Handan most of the year, and my older son too, so it's mostly me running the land with help from my daughter-in-law when she's not busy with the little one. Three and a half mu isn't a lot, but it keeps us in grain and a little cash.

I just do maize here — no wheat. Some folks in the village do the wheat-maize double crop but my plot is small and honestly the spring maize gives me a better yield because it has the whole season, not squeezed in after wheat. Less rushing around in June too.

**Seed:** I'll buy Zhengdan 958 again. I've used it maybe six, seven years running. My neighbor Old Li tried one of those new varieties two years back and it didn't handle the dry spell — I'm not taking that risk. About 35 yuan per mu of seed.

**Fertilizer:** Same as every year. One bag of compound fertilizer (that 15-15-15 stuff) before planting, about 40 kg per mu — that runs me around 140 yuan per mu, ouch but you can't skip it. Then when the maize is about knee-high I top-dress with urea, about half a bag per mu, maybe 20 kg. The shop guy told me once that's around 15 kg of nitrogen per mu all together. I know the big farmers put on more but I can't afford to throw money at the field.

**Planting:** End of April, when the ground warms up. The village tractor fellow comes around and rotary tills my plot for 40 yuan per mu. I don't have a tractor — wouldn't make sense on 3.5 mu anyway.

**Water:** I have a share in the well with three other households. Pumping isn't free. I'll water once right after planting to get it started, and once more around tasseling if the rain doesn't come. Two times if I have to. Last year we got lucky — rained at the right time and I only pumped once.

**Weeds and bugs:** I spray atrazine after planting for the weeds, everyone does that. If I see armyworm coming through I'll spray once with whatever the shop has — maybe 10 yuan per mu. My daughter-in-law and I pull weeds by hand where we can.

**Harvest:** Me and her do most of it by hand. I'll get one of the neighbors to help for a half day at harvest time, maybe 80 yuan total. My younger boy helps when he's home from school.

**Yield:** Last year I got 480 kg/mu. If the weather's decent I'm hoping for 500. If it's dry like 2023, maybe 420. You never know.
